findings.title: PDF active content markers (/JavaScript, /OpenAction) not rejected on upload
findings.description: validatePdfBuffer in src/server/pdfProcessor.ts accepted a synthetic PDF containing /JavaScript and /OpenAction dictionary entries without rejecting or stripping active content.
findings.remediation: Scan uploaded PDF buffers in validatePdfBuffer() for active-content tokens (/JavaScript, /JS, /OpenAction, /Launch, /AA) and reject with HTTP 422 before parsing.

findings.title: PDF magic header allows leading polyglot bytes (GIF/HTML prefix)
findings.description: validatePdfBuffer checks `headerSlice.includes("%PDF-")` across the first 1024 bytes rather than requiring `%PDF-` at byte offset 0, permitting GIF89a/HTML polyglot files.
findings.remediation: Require `buffer.subarray(0, 5).toString("latin1") === "%PDF-"` (allowing only optional UTF-8 BOM if needed) and reject non-zero magic offsets with HTTP 422.

findings.title: Oversized file (>10 MB) and JSON body (>4 MB) limits
findings.description: Oversized PDF (>10 MB) rejected with 413; oversized JSON body (>4 MB) rejected with HTTP 500.
findings.remediation: Keep Multer 10 MB limit and Express JSON 4 MB cap enforced; optionally map PayloadTooLargeError explicitly to HTTP 413.

findings.title: Prompt injection isolation in deterministic matching & scoring
findings.description: Deterministic scoring engine and verbatim JD evidence verification prevented injected resume instructions from overriding scores or injecting unverified quotes.
findings.remediation: Maintain deterministic server-side scoring and consider adding explicit delimiter framing around untrusted resume text in LLM extraction prompts.

findings.title: Missing API rate limiting on AI analysis and coaching endpoints
findings.description: No rate-limiting headers (RateLimit-Limit / X-RateLimit-Limit) or throttling middleware were detected on /api/analyze, /api/analyze-stream, /api/jd/quick-scan, or /api/coach.
findings.remediation: Add express-rate-limit (e.g., 10 analyses/15min per IP on /api/analyze* and 30 req/15min on /api/coach and /api/jd/quick-scan) with standard RateLimit-* headers and HTTP 429 responses.

findings.title: No server-side concurrency cap on /api/analyze and /api/analyze-stream
findings.description: While the QA test runner enforces a single-flight execution mutex, the primary /api/analyze and /api/analyze-stream routes do not cap simultaneous in-flight PDF parsing and Gemini API pipelines.
findings.remediation: Introduce a bounded concurrency counter (e.g. max 4–6 simultaneous analyses) on /api/analyze* returning HTTP 503 with Retry-After when saturated.

findings.title: Untrusted client-supplied compatibilityScore persisted by POST /api/analyses/save
findings.description: In server.ts, POST /api/analyses/save stores `Number(body.compatibilityScore) || 0` directly from the request payload without recomputing from skill matches or clamping to [0, 100], allowing authenticated users to forge saved scores.
findings.remediation: Recompute compatibilityScore and scoreBreakdown server-side using calculateCompatibilityScore() before inserting into PostgreSQL, or sign session analysis payloads with a server HMAC.

findings.title: Unauthorized access & cross-user IDOR isolation
findings.description: Unauthenticated requests to /api/analyses/* and /api/qa/* consistently returned HTTP 401, and repository queries strictly scope read/update/delete by authenticated userId.
findings.remediation: Maintain requireAuth/requireAdmin middleware and userId-scoped Drizzle predicates on all resource endpoints.

findings.title: Server technology fingerprinting header (X-Powered-By: Express) exposed
findings.description: API responses include the "X-Powered-By: Express" header. No API keys, credentials, or stack traces were exposed.
findings.remediation: Call `app.disable("x-powered-by")` in server.ts during Express initialization.

findings.title: Missing baseline HTTP security headers on core API responses
findings.description: Live probe of GET /api/health observed missing headers: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Cache-Control: no-store.
findings.remediation: Add a global Express security-headers middleware (or helmet configured for iframe compatibility) setting X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy, and Cache-Control: no-store on /api/*.

findings.title: Dependency vulnerability audit (0 known vulnerabilities)
findings.description: Live `bun audit` scan reported 0 known vulnerabilities across installed dependencies.
findings.remediation: Continue running dependency audits on every release and PR.

findings.title: Malformed JSON status mapping and /api/* 404 JSON boundary
findings.description: Observed error-handling gaps: malformed JSON returned HTTP 500 (expected 400); unknown /api/* path returned HTTP 200 (text/html) instead of 404 JSON.
findings.remediation: Add a `/api/*` 404 JSON catch-all route before Vite/static SPA fallback, and map `SyntaxError` / `entity.parse.failed` in formatApiError() to HTTP 400.
